SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3539.
Date 21 / 4 / 33

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.4253 of April 18 regarding three bandits named
Kung Deu Ah Loh (空頭阿洛) and Sung Kyung Sung
(沈晉生) and Kau Kwei Yeu (高貴友) and to
inform you that the matter will receive attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Sgd:- (R. C. AIERS)

Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

The President,
Shanghai 1st Special District Court.

復者接准
貴院四月十八日第四二五三號大函讀悉
協緝空頭阿六沈晉生及高貴友三名
匪案由准此敝部自當如
囑辦理隨時予以協助也相應玉復即希
查照為荷此致
上海第一特區地方法院院長周

副警務部長 安士
兼刑事處處長

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.
No. 4988                                                                 April    18,      1932.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

    I have received a letter No. 14 from the
Bandit Suppression Bureau of Wootow and Sungkiang
stating that bandits have been operating very actively
in their districts recently. They have frequently
pirated steamships and committed robberies. Should
suppressive measures be not immediately taken, there
would be a menace to peaceful travelling. It has
been confidentially reported that the following named
bandits, Kong Deu Ah Loh (空頭阿六), Shung Tsung Sheng
(沈普生) and Kau Kwei You (高貴友) have taken
their refuges in the International Settlement and
French Concession in Shanghai. Their detectives
have been dispatched to institute enquiries as to
their whereabouts in order to bring about their
apprehension. I have been requested to communicate
with you to seek for available assistance if they
may require.

                                                Tseu Sien Choh
                                                  President.

上海第一特區地方法院来函译文。
编号 4988                                                                 1932年4月18日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，
上海。

诸位先生：

    本人收到吳縣與松江剿匪局第14號來信，稱該等地區近期匪患猖獗。匪徒頻繁劫掠輪船並實施搶劫。若不立即採取鎮壓措施，將對平安出行構成威脅。據密報，下列 named 匪徒，即空頭阿六（Kong Deu Ah Loh）、沈普生（Shung Tsung Sheng）及高貴友（Kau Kwei You），已潛伏於上海公共租界及法租界內。其偵探已被派遣調查其行蹤，以便將其逮捕。本人受託與閣下聯繫，若他們需要，尋求可提供的協助。

                                                周先作
                                                  院長
